verdict.rationale: BigQuery exposes a documented, machine-readable REST API (v2 discovery doc confirmed live with resources for datasets/jobs/models/tables), plus gRPC Storage Write API, client SDKs, ODBC/JDBC drivers, and a Python-based bq CLI, all publicly documented and independently verified via runtime probe. missing for 10: no llms.txt or standalone OpenAPI spec file was found (404s), and the MCP server integration requires credential-gated setup rather than being fully turnkey.
